summary: The navigator collections view shows SHADOWED (another copy of the collection is higher in the search order and playbooks prefer it), TYPE (inside the execution environment or bind_mount volume-mounted into it) and PATH (where the collection lives in the EE or on the local file system).
questions: What does SHADOWED mean in ansible-navigator collections?
What is a bind_mount collection in ansible-navigator?
How do I tell which copy of a collection a playbook will use?
